text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hmm... That's a tough one, Flower-chan.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Akebono, Flower. Is something troubling 
you?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, I was tilling the field. As part of my 
duties for the Beautification Committee.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"I was helping out too. But you know... 
the furrows just kept coming out 
crooked~!"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: ! What did you say...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it goes crooked because the field is 
so big... Still, it's for the sake of the 
veggies! I'll do my best, yeah!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Then I shall lend a hand. Going in a 
straight line is my specialty.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Lend me the hoe. I'll make this ridge 
straight as an arrow too.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Heh—haaah!
(Crunch, crunch, crunch, crunch, crunch!)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Wah... a-amazing...! To think you could 
make it in such a straight line!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
And it was over in a flash! Right O-san, 
you're a genius at straightening things 
out!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
...Mmh, wait. I'm curious about that field 
over there, too.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
It's off by about two millimeters. I must 
make it perfectly straight!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
T-Two millimeters!? I think that much 
should be fine, right...?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"No, never! I will straighten out every 
single field in this plot! Uwooooh!!"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Alright, now that's a perfect straight 
line. ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! What a beautiful field! Thank you 
so much. Once the vegetables are 
harvested, I'll share some with you♪

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Phew, that was refreshing. Though I did 
end up getting my shoes muddy.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Borrowing a rag—hm, what's this? A 
cardboard box full of tools?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Gah!? This is... Every single one of them 
is bent completely out of shape...?!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
A broom, a fork, and a metal tape measure. 
Look at all these straight tools...!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"There's no way I could miss it... That a 
straight line has been bent!"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Without wavering in the slightest, 
extending straight ahead! That is the 
beautiful form known as a straight line!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Just like the Niigata Racecourse 
straightaway! I'll make it straight as an 
arrrrrow!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Haaaaah! Strike with the hammer, strike, 
strike!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Kuh, there are so many of them...! But if 
you think something like this... will 
break me, you've got another thing 
comiiiiing!!

While walking through the school building, 
I saw Calstone Light O. For some reason, a 
pile of equipment was stacked beside 
her...
Aaaaah?! That equipment, could it be...?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I knew it! They've all been repaired 
straight as an arrow!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Everything here was bent and unusable 
equipment! Wait, don't tell me... did you 
do this!?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I made it straight as an arrow. To 
the point where it's utterly mesmerizing, 
really.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
~~...gh! Thanks for doing this for Tracen 
Academy! You're a model student, for real!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of the academy? I simply 
cannot abide anything crooked or unjust.
choice_data_list:
That conviction is what led to helping 
people.

That conviction is what led to helping 
people.

Maybe that's why Light O is such a 
straightforward Umamusume, too.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Goodness. Me, helping someone?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I was super moved by it! That 
conviction of yours is amazing!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I see. If they were pleased, then I 
certainly don't feel bad about it.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I won't waver in my 
feelings. I'll straighten out anything, no 
matter what it takes.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Fufu, of course it is! Yay, hooray.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll keep pushing straight ahead, 
more and more, from here on out.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
When making okonomiyaki, it has to be a 
rectangle made of straight lines! And the 
only ingredient will be long, straight 
pork.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? Charging straight ahead with such 
fiery spirit! Splendid, I say!
